interpretation.executable_path: All executable hard semantic cases were planned on the first pass, routed to the correct deterministic native tool with correct arguments, and executed successfully across three repetitions.
interpretation.dataset_selection: Explicit multi-dataset requests selected the intended dataset, while an unspecified compatible multi-dataset request abstained as ambiguous.
interpretation.semantic_fidelity: Exact identifiers such as revenue, net_revenue and profit_margin remained distinct; absent margin was not silently substituted.
interpretation.ambiguity: Under-specified requests such as performance by region did not trigger an invented metric; unsupported or ambiguous requests abstained safely.
interpretation.temporal_typing: String-based fiscal_period values were classified as temporal at ingestion using conservative name-plus-parseability rules.
interpretation.scope_warning: This is a controlled synthetic benchmark. It is strong evidence for the covered scenarios, not a general reliability guarantee.
